name: SPY ATR band mean-reversion (x-bookmark scan, rank 1)
hypothesis: SPY mean-reverts after an ATR-band range extension: buying when price pulls back inside the ATR band after a breakout, long/short, beats holding over multi-decade monthly bars.

rules.entry: Mean-reversion polarity (best of 4 configs: ma20/k2.5/atr14); enter when price crosses back inside the ATR band after an extension.
rules.exit: Opposite band cross or mean-reversion target as defined in the scan config.
rules.position_sizing: All-in/out per bar in the scan model; sizing model not yet pinned for JARVIS.
rules.risk_limits: None in scan model; JARVIS gates apply (mc_95th_dd floor, DSR).
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Gross of commission/slippage in gate reasons (per card note).

metrics.fees_slippage_assumption: gross (card reports in-market PnL before close/open spread + financing)

known_failure_modes: Monte Carlo 95th drawdown 27.4% far above 6.0% floor
DSR 0.0 at selection trial count — edge is a multiple-testing artifact
